title: Guaranteed Resale Program Terms: Appraisal, Guaranteed Offer and Purchase Closing
content:
**Terms of the guarantee — In-Place Home Resale, Guaranteed Resale Program.** The guarantee exists only on a package that offers a guaranteed purchase, which among the In-Place Home Resale packages is the Guaranteed Resale Program. The package on the file, as the company's records show it, decides whether an appraisal or a guaranteed purchase belongs to the guarantee at all.

1. *Retired, no longer in force:* the clause under which the guarantee required an independent appraisal charged at the package's appraisal fee on the appraisal date, before the home is listed. That clause is superseded by the current basis for the appraisal and its charge.
2. **The guaranteed offer.** When the listing term ends with the home listed and not under contract, Hearthstone offers to buy it at the package's guaranteed percentage of the appraised value, less the contractor cost of any required repairs not yet completed, rounded half up to the cent. The seller may accept or let the listing expire.
3. **Age of the appraisal.** The appraisal must be no older than the package's appraisal validity period on the last day of the listing term; an older appraisal is redone at Hearthstone's cost before the offer is made.
4. **Closing the guaranteed purchase.** An accepted guaranteed purchase closes within the package's guaranteed-purchase closing period in calendar days after the listing term ends, under the same closing conditions as any other sale except the buyer-residency approval, since Hearthstone itself is the buyer.

## Condition and result

| At the end of the listing term | Result |
|---|---|
| home listed, not under contract, package offers the guarantee | Hearthstone offers to buy at the guaranteed price; the seller accepts or lets the listing expire |
| appraisal older than the validity period on the last day of the term | the appraisal is redone at Hearthstone's cost before the offer is made |
| seller accepts | the guaranteed purchase closes within the closing period after the term ends |

## Guaranteed price (hypothetical appraisals on the Guaranteed Resale Program, 85.00 percent)

| Appraised value | 85.00 percent | Contractor cost of required repairs not completed | Guaranteed offer |
|---|---|---|---|
| 80000.00 | 68000.00 | none | 68000.00 |
| 80000.00 | 68000.00 | 1250.00 | 66750.00 |
| 76543.21 | 65061.7285 | none | 65061.73 (rounded half up) |

superseded_clauses: The guarantee requires an independent appraisal, charged at appraisal_fee on the appraisal date, before the home is listed.
